t: I heard the baby cry before anyone opened the door. Both of them made it.
I was there when the baby came. It was loud, messy, and worth every minute.
The mother held on, and the little one came out shouting. I saw the whole thing.
I carried water in and heard that first cry. Everyone in the room started breathing again.
The baby has a strong set of lungs. I could hear it from {outside|across} the house.
I saw the little one bundled up afterward. Small, red-faced, and doing fine.
It took {most|half} of the night, but the baby came safely. Nobody wanted to leave afterward.
I waited by the door until they said both were safe. Best thing I heard all day.
The little one grabbed my finger and would not let go. Strong already.
I watched them clean the baby up. The crying did not stop, which suited everyone fine.
They needed every clean cloth in the place, but mother and baby are safe.
I saw the family together afterward. Tired faces all around, but happy ones.
A baby was born {last night|before dawn}. Mother and child are both doing well.
They say the birth took all night, but everyone came through safely.
There is a new baby in the village. You can hear it from halfway across the square.
I heard they used every blanket in the house. The baby is warm and healthy.
The news is good for once. A child was born, and both of them are safe.
Someone said the baby came before dawn. The whole household is still awake.
They have another mouth to feed and could not look happier about it.
I heard the little one has plenty of hair already. Everyone has an opinion about it.
The baby arrived safely. People have been finding excuses to pass the house all {morning|day}.
Word is the mother is resting and the baby is hungry. That sounds healthy enough.
A child was born across the village. I have not met the little one yet.
The birth went well, from what reached me. Good news takes its time getting this far.
Someone farther in had a baby. I only know that both survived.
They are passing word about a new child. I could not tell you which house.
{god} kept watch through that birth. I was there, and I know what I felt.
Both lived. Maybe that was {god}, or maybe we were lucky. I will take either.
It was hard work and good hands that saved them. We do not need a miracle for everything.
They say {god} watched over the birth. I say the healer deserves some credit too.
